title: DewaxGuard Findings Table v1
description: Inter-phase contract for findings. Superset of the FINDING | pipe-delimited prose format emitted by hacking-agents. Phases that need machine-readable findings (dedup, severity-router, report) parse prose into this schema. Phases that emit findings may emit prose alone and let the parser fill the table.

version.description: Schema version. Bump on breaking changes.

audit_id.description: Stable identifier for this audit (e.g. project + commit hash + date).

phase.description: Which phase produced this table snapshot.

id.description: Phase-local ID (e.g. AC-1, EC-3, RS1-2). Stable within a phase, may be rewritten downstream by dedup/severity-router.

canonical_id.description: Set by dedup. The ID of the canonical finding this row was merged into. NULL if this row IS the canonical.

report_id.description: Set by severity-router/report-index. Final client-facing ID (C-01, H-03, M-12, L-04, I-08).

kind.description: FINDING = exploitable, has proof + verified. LEAD = partial, needs further investigation.

agent.description: Source agent (access-control, economic-security, execution-trace, periphery, math-precision, invariant, vector-scan, first-principles, feynman, state-inconsistency, depth-lowlevel, depth-runtime, rescan, percontract, niche-*).

bug_class.description: Kebab-case vulnerability class tag (e.g. missing-auth, reentrancy, oracle-staleness, sync-gap, off-by-one).

group_key.description: ContractName | functionName | bug_class. Primary dedup key — same group_key = same root cause until proven otherwise.

severity.description: Final severity. NULL until severity-router has run.

severity_pre_modifier.description: Severity from raw Impact×Likelihood matrix before downgrade modifiers (on-chain-only, view-only, trusted-actor). NULL if no modifier applied.

impact_level.description: Impact axis input for severity matrix.

likelihood.description: Likelihood axis input for severity matrix.

extra_locations.description: Additional locations for consolidated findings (same root cause, multiple sites).

title.description: Short title (≤80 chars). Derived from description if not set explicitly.

description.description: Plain-English description (per rules/plain-english-style.md). Four-sentence shape: what is wrong → why it matters → who triggers it → what the user sees.

path.description: Attack path: caller → function → state change → impact.

proof.description: Concrete values, trace, or state sequence demonstrating the bug. Required for kind=FINDING.

verified.description: Pasted ±2 lines of source around cited line. Required for kind=FINDING.

evidence_tags.description: Evidence tags backing the finding. POC-PASS is the only tag that supports CONFIRMED ground truth. DIFF/CONFORMANCE/NON-DET/FUZZ added for L1 mode (v1.14).

verdict.description: Set by verifier in Phase 5. NULL pre-verification.

verifier_notes.description: Verifier output summary (PoC compile attempts, fuzz runs, fork-test addresses).

confidence.description: 4-axis confidence from phase4-confidence-scoring.md. NULL fields until scoring runs.

rules_applied.description: Per finding-output-format.md (e.g. R4:✓, R6:✗(no role)). Strings preserve the ✓/✗ markers.

satisfied_by_finding.description: Canonical ID of another finding whose postcondition creates this precondition. Used by chain analysis.

chain_id.description: If this finding is part of a chain, the chain hypothesis ID (CH-N).

agent_source_paths.description: Scratchpad paths where this finding originated (e.g. scratchpad/analysis_access_control.md).

tool_budget_exhausted.description: True if the agent ran out of Read/Grep budget while investigating this row.

duplicate_of_v12.description: If M-25 V12 grep matched, the V12 finding ID. Triggers DROP.
